# ChatGPT (Android) Play Pulse

**Window:** 2026-08-26 → 2026-09-09 · **Cleaned reviews:** 9,428. Note: full 2026-07-16–2026-09-10 lookback not covered yet.

## Top themes
1. **Image & photo generation limits** (n=1170) — Photo/image upload or generation caps, slow image creates, vision limits.
2. **Paywall / limits / upgrade friction** (n=555) — Free-tier chat caps, Plus/Go/Pro upgrade nags, billing and subscription pain.
3. **Answer quality / misunderstandings** (n=311) — Wrong answers, flip-flopping when corrected, not understanding the user.

## User quotes
1. "it is like the dumbest creature I have ever seen. one time I took a photo of my chemistry book and told it read and for every word"
2. "the bot is good but you telling me that I can go and use Gemini and I dont have any problems I can keep chatting for as long"
3. "it started lying to me. I'm trying to do a book because I'm dying of a disease I got this app because I was told it was the"

## Action ideas
1. **Make image/photo quotas understandable and fair** — Users complain about limited photo generation/upload; explain caps and improve fallback messaging.
2. **Clarify free-tier limits before users hit the wall** — Reviews cite abrupt chat/photo caps and upgrade nags; surface remaining quota earlier.
3. **Reduce confident-wrong answers and flip-flops** — 1★ reviews describe incorrect answers that agree after correction; tighten grounding and correction UX.
